name: 黑腹濱鷸
illustrationTaxon: Calidris alpina (subspecies in Hong Kong probably sakhalina, kistchinski or actites) in non-breeding plumage, the plumage in which most birds are seen: 16-22 cm, the most abundant wintering sandpiper in Hong Kong and larger than the stints with a noticeably longer bill. All plumages have black legs and a relatively long black bill that is almost straight but slightly decurved near the tip. In non-breeding plumage the upperparts are plain grey-brown with streaking on the crown and slightly darker lores, and the underparts are whitish with faint streaking across the chest; first-winter birds show clear-cut pale fringes to the wing coverts before these are replaced. In breeding plumage the head is pale, the upperpart feathers are rufous and there is a bold black belly patch; birds migrating through Hong Kong in April are often in near-complete breeding plumage. The flight call is a dry trill. It feeds tactually on intertidal invertebrates.

similarSpecies.distinction: 彎嘴濱鷸腳較長、嘴較長而下彎更明顯、腰及尾上覆羽非全白；本種腳較短、嘴長但只有末端略為下彎，體態較低矮。
尖尾濱鷸有鮮明的白色眉紋與橙紅頭頂、腳帶欖黃色；本種頭頂只是灰褐縱紋、眉紋較淡、腳全黑而嘴較長且略下彎。

featureNotes: 嘴黑色、相對長，整體近乎筆直，只在末端略為下彎——與彎嘴濱鷸整段下彎的嘴不同（第1圈取自全身圖，實際可見）。
頭頂是灰褐色並帶深色縱紋，眉紋淡而不醒目；繁殖羽時頭部反而顯得偏淡（第2圈取自近景圖，實際可見）。
非繁殖羽下體大致白色，只有胸部有一道淡淡的灰褐縱紋，不會像繁殖羽那樣出現大片黑腹（第3圈取自近景圖，實際可見）。
腳全黑而相對短，站姿低矮——與腳較長的彎嘴濱鷸並排時最易分辨（第4圈取自全身圖，實際可見）。

sources.use: HKBWS substantive read: Category I, an abundant winter visitor and scarce on passage, and the most abundant wintering sandpiper in Hong Kong; 16-22 cm; in all plumages the legs are black and the bill is relatively long, black and slightly decurved near the tip; in non-breeding plumage the upperparts are plain grey-brown with streaking on the crown and slightly darker lores and the underparts are whitish with faint streaking across the chest, while first-winter birds show clear-cut pale fringes to the wing coverts before these are replaced; in breeding plumage the head is pale, the upperpart feathers are rufous and there is a black belly patch, and birds migrating through Hong Kong in April are often in near-complete breeding plumage; the flight call is a dry trill; compared with Curlew Sandpiper the legs are shorter, the bill less decurved and the rump not wholly white; most records come from the intertidal mudflats of Deep Bay but the winter roost is not at Mai Po Nature Reserve, where the species is relatively rare, though passage birds join the wader roosts there; elsewhere small numbers of up to seven between 20 September and 13 January apart from 17 at Tai Po on 15 December 1979, also at Long Valley, Chek Lap Kok, Sha Tau Kok and occasionally fish ponds; the earliest autumn record is 26 July 2017 with numbers in single figures until mid-September, Hong Kong being at the southern edge of the wintering range in East Asia, building through October and November; numbers were high in the 1990s, low in the 2000s and notably high in the 2010s, with the highest count on the Hong Kong side 6,070 on 13 December 2020 and 6,141 in all of Deep Bay on the same date; numbers fall markedly from the end of February to the first half of March, with the highest this century 590 against 2,000 historically, while April is very poor with only one to three birds, up to 20 in the first week and 13 in the second, no more than two on any May date and the latest 20 June 2003, and there are no summering records; Vaughan & Jones (1913) called it exceedingly common and Dove & Goodhart (1955) gave 19 August to 2 May; it feeds tactually on intertidal invertebrates and the roost is unknown, presumably on the north side of Deep Bay; the species is Holarctic and breeds largely north of the Arctic Circle, with ten subspecies of which sakhalina, kistchinski and actites are likely in Hong Kong, breeding in eastern Russia to the Sea of Okhotsk and Kuriles and wintering in East Asia; IUCN Near Threatened with a decreasing population, having declined by 20-29% over three generations.

HKBWS Sharp-tailed Sandpiper comparison: a similarly sized Calidris with a bold white supercilium, rufous crown and olive-yellow legs, against Dunlin's grey-brown streaked crown, faint supercilium and all-black legs.

notes: AI 生成插圖，經人眼核對嘴長而略下彎、頭頂灰褐縱紋、胸部淡縱紋及黑色短腳；描繪非繁殖羽（香港冬季所見絕大多數為此羽色），未畫繁殖羽的黑腹斑。
兩隻比較鳥均為 AI 生成示意（彎嘴濱鷸沿用 0143 全身圖、尖尾濱鷸沿用 0142 全身圖），非等比例；卡上不作完整鑑別檢索表。
地圖為 Natural Earth 110m 世界底圖的國家層級概述，不是精確分佈多邊形，繁殖地與越冬地不分工。
IUCN 近危 NT（三代間減少 20–29%）；香港屬 Category I，數量豐富的冬候鳥、過境時稀少，單日最高 6,070 隻（2020-12-13）。
